messages:
Marco (Sales): quick heads-up — BankCo wants SOC 2 artifacts + a signed pen-test attestation before legal will sign the POC. they also asked for staging creds, a network diagram, and an estimate for how Dedicated would change pricing. cc @Anya @Rachel
Anya (SE): we can share a SOC 2 Type II summary + control matrix excerpt. full report is org-only. for pen-test attestation, security usually provides a signed letter stating we completed an external pentest and high-level findings redacted. @Carlos can confirm the exact wording we can share.
Carlos (Security): confirm — we have a pen-test attestation template we can sign that does NOT include raw vuln lists. for Dedicated/Private we can also sign an authorization letter that defines the window and scope for customer-run tests. customer scans must be scheduled and limited to agreed IP ranges.
Marco (Sales): BankCo also insisted on SAML SSO for the admin users during POC. is that possible for a short trial?
Anya (SE): SAML is supported for Private and Dedicated. For Hosted we can create temporary org/service accounts + SCIM provisioning in many cases. For the POC, quickest path = hosted staging org + service account + IP allowlist.
Rachel (Compliance): I can assemble: SOC2 summary PDF, control matrix CSV excerpt, ISO27001 scope statement, and the pen-test attestation draft. how do we want to deliver? presigned S3, SFTP, or dropbox link?
Marco (Sales): presigned S3 + short README preferred. also they asked for a redacted network diagram and egress topology.
Carlos (Security): i'll produce a redacted network diagram (remove internal hostnames/IPs). pen-test attestation will include: scope, test date range, high-level findings (severity counts), and signature block. i can get it signed by security leadership EOD.
Anya (SE): FYI dedicated pricing will introduce reserved capacity charges. quick ballpark to share: Dedicated POC add-on = +$8k/month for a small pool (estimate, subject to quote). we can offer a 30% POC discount if they commit to a 3mo eval.
Marco (Sales): put that in an email to procurement. they also want to run a quick external scan during the POC — what's the process?
Carlos (Security): process: 1) send scan request + scope (IPs/domains) 2) schedule window (we coordinate with infra) 3) sign test rules (no exploitation beyond discovery), 4) results go to security only; we’ll redact before sharing. we require at least 48h notice.
Anya (SE): for presigned upload, i'll create a folder and share a small README. example cli to upload evidence:
```bash
aws s3 cp bankco-evidence.zip s3://redwood-poc-evidence/bankco/ --acl private --expires-in 3600
```
Rachel (Compliance): delivering via presigned S3 is fine. i will prepare the docs and the README with a short control mapping table.
Marco (Sales): can we include a short statement about data residency? BankCo wants EU-only processing during the POC.
Carlos (Security): we can route their POC to eu-west region for hosted. need to note: some telemetry/ops logs may still flow to central observability — i'll add a note and mitigation.
deploy-bot: ticket INF-1123 created for pen-test attestation sign-off by Security (assignee: Carlos).
Anya (SE): follow-ups: @Rachel — once docs are ready, i'll open the staging org and share SSO/service account setup steps. @Marco — please confirm whether they prefer Dedicated trial or Hosted with IP allowlist.
Marco (Sales): i'll ask procurement now and loop back within the hour. thanks all :thumbsup:
